C1386.title: Mirai Botnet Attacks Krebs on Security Blog
C1386.summary: In September 2016, security journalist Brian Krebs' website was hit by a DDoS attack peaking at about 620 Gbps, making it one of the largest publicly documented attacks at the time. The subsequently released Mirai source code showed malware that scanned the internet, used a list of common default credentials to access cameras, routers, and other IoT devices, and conscripted them into high-volume attacks.
